analyst.summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate has simplified into a pure real estate developer with a valuable land bank across major cities, backed by a strong promoter group, and its August 2026 sale of the legacy paper business to ITC completes that transition. But the current business is still loss-making, with earnings not covering interest expense, and the stock trades well above book value for a company with no demonstrated track record of translating its land bank into consistent profit. We would wait for sustained profitability before revisiting.
